statement1.title: Everything starts with a VISION.
statement1.subtitle: An idea. A better way of working. Something you want to bring to life.

statement2.title: Turning vision into TECHNOLOGY is complex.
statement2.subtitle: Ideas are simple. Making all the pieces work together isn't.

statement3.title: You bring the vision. We BUILD the technology.
statement3.subtitle: From websites and apps to AI, data, automation and everything underneath.

problemCards.author: Devint
problemCards.title: Manual Work
problemCards.challengeTitle: Too much time can disappear into repetitive work.
challengeBullets: Processes that happen again and again

problemCards.author: Devint
problemCards.title: Idea
problemCards.challengeTitle: You know what you want to create, but turning an idea into working technology can be difficult.
challengeBullets: Turning the concept into a working product
problemCards.closingLine: An idea needs a path to reality.

problemCards.author: Devint
problemCards.title: Digital Presence
problemCards.challengeTitle: Your digital presence should reflect the quality of what you do.
challengeBullets: A digital presence that doesn't represent you
problemCards.closingLine: Your work deserves a digital presence that does it justice.

problemCards.author: Devint
problemCards.title: Connection
problemCards.challengeTitle: Your tools shouldn't work in isolation.
problemCards.closingLine: Your technology should work as one.

problemCards.author: Devint
problemCards.title: Custom Software
problemCards.challengeTitle: Sometimes existing software simply doesn't fit the way you work.

problemCards.author: Devint
problemCards.title: User Experience
problemCards.challengeTitle: Something can work perfectly and still be difficult to use.

problemCards.author: Devint
problemCards.title: Growth
problemCards.challengeTitle: What works today may not be enough tomorrow.
problemCards.closingLine: Build for where you're going, not only where you are.

problemCards.author: Devint
problemCards.title: Data
problemCards.challengeTitle: Having data is one thing. Making it useful is another.
challengeBullets: Too much information, not enough clarity
